# AI 知识地图 / AI Knowledge Map

> 面向 AI 初学者与非技术读者的免费知识地图：把概念原理、专业资料库、AI 软件目录、使用教程和学习进度放在同一个静态站点里。概念页中的每一条解释都标注来源与认识论边界；资料库中的每一条资料都记录审核状态、证据用途与使用边界。

站点根：https://ai-knowledge-map.com/

## Tutorial chapter reading pages

- [如何写好 AI 提示词？任务、材料、边界与迭代](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/conversation-basics/) — 学习怎样向 AI 说明任务、提供必要材料、设置边界和提出可执行要求，并根据结果迭代提示词；配合原有交互流程、案例与常见问题继续练习。
- [How to Write AI Prompts: Tasks, Context, Constraints and Iteration](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/conversation-basics/) — Learn to describe tasks, provide necessary context, set constraints and give actionable requirements, then revise prompts based on results. Continue with the interactive workflow, examples and FAQ.
- [什么是 AI Agent？与模型、工作流有什么区别](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-foundations/) — 理解 AI Agent、模型与工作流的关系，认识行动和反馈循环，以及工具、知识、记忆的作用，判断何时需要 Agent、怎样设置自主性和权限。
- [What Is an AI Agent? Models, Workflows, Tools and Memory](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/agent-foundations/) — Understand how agents relate to models and workflows, how action and feedback loops work, and what tools, knowledge and memory do. Learn when an agent is appropriate and how to set permissions.
- [如何制作 AI Agent：知识库、记忆、语音与后台运行](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-building/) — 从话题助手开始，学习为 Agent 配置知识库、跨对话记忆与语音交流，设置定时和事件触发的后台任务，并了解发布、维护与开源许可。
- [How to Build an AI Agent: Knowledge, Memory, Voice and Background Tasks](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/agent-building/) — Start with a topic assistant, add a knowledge base, cross-conversation memory and voice, then configure scheduled or event-triggered background tasks. Review publishing, maintenance and licensing.
- [去哪里找 AI Agent、Skill、Harness 和现成工作流](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-discovery/) — 分清 Agent、Skill 与 Harness 的作用，查找现成 Agent、技能、运行程序和工作流的具体资源入口，并了解各类资源在使用前需要核对的条件。
- [Where to Find AI Agents, Skills, Harnesses and Workflows](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/agent-discovery/) — Distinguish agents, skills and harnesses, then explore specific directories and repositories for reusable agents, skills, runtimes and workflows, including conditions to check before use.
- [如何设计 AI 自动化工作流：任务拆分、分支与反馈](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/automation/) — 学习拆分工作流、分配模型与程序和人的职责、设计分支及检查反馈，并通过入职指南、邮件日程、客户咨询等十个案例理解完整处理路径。
- [How to Design AI Workflows: Steps, Branches and Feedback Loops](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/automation/) — Learn to split workflows, assign work to models, programs and people, and design branches and checks. Explore ten examples, including onboarding guides, email-to-calendar tasks and customer inquiries.
- [如何评估与改进 AI Agent：LangSmith 测试集与评分](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-evaluation/) — 认识四类评估工具，按 LangSmith 教学步骤准备测试集、设置评分、解读报告并比较提示词版本；保留课程对资料核对、演示结果和未完整试跑的说明。
- [How to Evaluate AI Agents: LangSmith Datasets, Scoring and Iteration](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/agent-evaluation/) — Explore four types of evaluation tools, a LangSmith walkthrough for datasets and scoring, and prompt-version comparisons. The chapter retains its documentation checks and untested-demo limitations.
- [编程入门先学什么？五个核心环节与重要技术](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/ai-coding/coding-foundations/) — 从明确问题、搜集信息、设计方法、编写运行到验证改进，理解编程的五个核心环节，并认识运行环境、程序结构、Git、测试与调试等重要技术。
- [Programming Basics: Five Core Stages, Git, Testing and Debugging](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/ai-coding/coding-foundations/) — Follow five programming stages, from defining a problem and gathering information to designing, coding and checking results. Learn what environments, program structure, Git, testing and debugging do.
- [AI 如何辅助编程：需求、设计、代码、测试与调试](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/ai-coding/coding-assistance/) — 沿着编程的五个核心环节，了解可直接使用的 Agent、Skill 和工具，学习让 AI 协助明确需求、搜集信息、设计程序、编写代码及定位和改进问题。
- [How AI Helps with Programming: Requirements, Design, Code and Tests](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/ai-coding/coding-assistance/) — Explore agents, skills and tools across five programming stages. Learn how AI can help define requirements, gather information, design programs, write and run code, and investigate errors.
- [AI 图像生成工作流：Midjourney、Stable Diffusion 与参数控制](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/image-creation/image-generation/) — 学习专业图像生成中的文生图、参考图、图生图、局部重绘与扩图，理解 ControlNet、LoRA 和参数对比，并查阅 Midjourney 与 Stable Diffusion 教程。
- [AI Image Workflows: Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, ControlNet and LoRA](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/image-creation/image-generation/) — Explore text-to-image, reference images, image-to-image, inpainting and outpainting. Learn the roles of ControlNet and LoRA, compare generation settings and save reusable image workflows.
- [如何让 AI Agent 操作 Photoshop：MCP 接入与排查](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/image-creation/image-photoshop-agent/) — 比较 Photoshop 内置助手与外部 Agent 的接入方式，了解 UXP 插件和 Windows COM 两种 MCP 方案、连接验证、任务表达及常见接入问题。
- [Connect AI Agents to Photoshop: MCP, UXP and Windows COM](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/image-creation/image-photoshop-agent/) — Compare Photoshop's built-in assistant with external agents. Review UXP and Windows COM MCP integrations, connection checks, task instructions and common setup problems.
- [如何复用 AI 图像工作流：人物一致性、商品图与放大](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/image-creation/image-workflow-reuse/) — 按人物一致性、商品重新布光、局部修改和图片放大，查阅 IP-Adapter FaceID、ComfyUI Inpainting 与 ESRGAN 案例，核对复用前的准备和结果记录。
- [Reuse AI Image Workflows: Consistent Characters, Product Images and Upscaling](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/image-creation/image-workflow-reuse/) — Explore IP-Adapter FaceID, product relighting, ComfyUI inpainting and ESRGAN upscaling examples. Check the preparation and result records needed before reusing an image workflow.
- [AI 视频生成怎么入门？即梦、通义万相与海螺教程](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/video-creation/video-generation/) — 分清视频模型、平台与工作流，了解即梦、通义万相和海螺的教程入口，学习提示词、参考素材、镜头运动及一致性等视频生成控制点。
- [Getting Started with AI Video: Jimeng, Wan and Hailuo Tutorials](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/video-creation/video-generation/) — Distinguish video models, platforms and workflows. Find Jimeng, Wan and Hailuo learning resources and explore controls for prompts, references, camera movement and consistency.
- [如何用 AI Agent 剪辑视频：达芬奇与 Premiere 接入](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/video-creation/video-editing-agent/) — 了解 DaVinci Resolve Studio 与 Adobe Premiere Pro 的 Agent 接入方式，核对版本和脚本条件，连接外部工具，并检查视频工程操作的结果及常见问题。
- [AI Agents for Video Editing: DaVinci Resolve and Premiere Integration](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/video-creation/video-editing-agent/) — Review agent integrations for DaVinci Resolve Studio and Adobe Premiere Pro. Check versions and scripting requirements, connect external tools and inspect editing results and common problems.
- [新人如何复用 AI 视频工作流：即梦、Wan 与 H3 案例](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/video-creation/video-workflow-reuse/) — 跟随原作者的即梦动画、产品展示、赛车分镜、Wan 角色替换及 H3 样片确认案例，核对教程、素材获取条件与版本，再选择可以跟做的工作流。
- [AI Video Workflows for Beginners: Jimeng, Wan and H3 Examples](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/video-creation/video-workflow-reuse/) — Follow creator tutorials for animation, product videos, storyboards, Wan character replacement and H3 preview approval. Check materials, access conditions and versions before reusing a workflow.
